messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] service=node-provisioner severity=high image_pull_fail_rate=34% repo=docker.io/nvidia/cuda:11.8-runtime — paging oncall @sam

sam (oncall): ack — looking

maya (sre): seeing lots of 401 / 429 / 503 from docker.io in kubelet logs, several ImagePullBackOffs on new nodes

maya (sre): log snippet:
```
May 20 09:13:02 kubelet[1234]: W0205 09:13:02.123456 1 pod_workers.go:191] Error syncing pod \"job-xyz\": failed to pull image \"docker.io/nvidia/cuda:11.8-runtime\": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to pull image: unauthorized: authentication required
May 20 09:13:02 kubelet[1234]: E0205 09:13:02.123457 1 remote_image.go:321] pull access denied or too many requests: toomanyrequests: You have reached your pull rate limit
```

sam (oncall): autoscaler stuck? new nodes not joining?

maya (sre): yes — cluster-autoscaler loop, instance provisioned but kubelet stays in CrashLoop due to ImagePullBackOff; affects spot pools and batch-workers-prod pools

lina (platform eng): our node bootstrap references docker.io directly for CUDA images in cloud-init. we do have an internal mirror (gcr.redwood-internal) but node bootstrap isn't using it today

frank (support): receiving customer complaints about slow job start and timeouts since ~09:12 UTC. two enterprise customers escalated.

sam (oncall): mitigation plan (short): 1) switch node bootstrap to use internal mirror for cuda images 2) apply pre-pull on new nodes via init script 3) temporarily scale existing warm pool to cover jobs

lina (platform eng): I can patch cloud-init template. prepping snippet to rewrite registries.conf to point docker.io -> gcr mirror

lina (platform eng): cloud-init snippet:
```
cat > /etc/containers/registries.conf <<EOF
[[registry]]
prefix = \"docker.io\"
location = \"gcr.redwood-internal\"
EOF
```

deploy-bot: starting rolling update for nodepool batch-workers-prod — 0/120 updated

maya (sre): applying patched cloud-init to ASG launch template now; will force new instances to use internal mirror. kicking off pre-pull job to populate mirror for cuda images

mirror-admin: increased mirror cache TTL and started prefetch for nvidia/cuda:11.8-runtime across regions

maya (sre): partial success: newly provisioned nodes now boot cleanly with image from gcr.redwood-internal, autoscaler resumed, image pull error rate down to ~6%

sam (oncall): good. frank, please send initial customer update. include ETA 20-30m and note we're migrating to internal mirror.

frank (support): sent to affected customers: \"We're investigating an image registry issue impacting job startup. Mitigation underway via internal mirror; ETA 20-30 minutes. We'll follow up when fully resolved.\" :envelope_with_arrow:

maya (sre): still seeing sporadic 401s for legacy pools that haven't rotated launch templates. patching those next

lina (platform eng): granting mirror read capacity to CI/CD and node boot accounts, monitoring QPS

sam (oncall): vendor check — Docker Hub status shows degraded in some regions, opened support case referencing rate-limits + auth failures. also evaluating longer-term mirror fallback and token refresh improvements

mirror-admin: increased token refresh cadence for mirror auth, started backfill of top 50 images used by prod

maya (sre): hypothesis: Docker Hub rate limiting + expired/insufficient tokens in mirror auth path produced intermittent 401s for some nodes. combined with heavy autoscale churn created burst pulls 

sam (oncall): handoff plan: I'll keep eyes on this until 11:30 UTC then handoff to @lina. summary to include: what changed (cloud-init -> gcr.mirror), affected pools, customer impact, mitigations applied, follow-ups (postmortem + infra fixes)

lina (platform eng): ack — will monitor mirror health and coordinate with infra to increase mirror capacity if needed

sam (oncall): post-incident action items (short list):
- bake mirror into node AMIs / machine images for all pools
- add pre-pull init-job for critical images (gpu drivers, cuda, runtime)
- add alert: ImagePullBackOff > 5% for > 5m triggers paging to oncall
- implement token refresh + retry logic in mirror auth path
- schedule postmortem and customer-impact review

frank (support): tracking impacted customers: CUST-1234, CUST-5678. opening follow-up tickets with timeline

maya (sre): monitoring shows sustained errors resolved, autoscaler behavior normalizing

incident-bot: [RESOLVED] service=node-provisioner status=mitigated at=1782058599 note=\"mirror fallback applied, autoscaler resumed\"

sam (oncall): marking incident mitigated at 1782058599. I'll open a postmortem doc and assign action items to owners. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
